description: Railway Engineering Dataset for Studying Consistency in Mobile Edge Computing Environment is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors yannan wang. "The railway engineering data are categorized by engineering types (e.g. mechanical, architectural, structural) and further divided into fine-grained spatial locations such as the ground floor, mezzanine, and platform. Each location model is stored as a file distributed across edge servers, with user requests indexed by file names. ". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
